independence.prior_report_exposure: Before source retrieval, a combined Get-Content call read the full input brief and the November 2 Markdown report for layout. Tool output was truncated but exposed earlier findings. No text was copied as source evidence; all eight source responses were retrieved afresh. This limits fresh-context independence. After Part A was committed and pushed, the first 50 lines of the November 2 Markdown report were read again solely to match its leading status-table layout.
independence.held_files: Held verdicts deliberately read by Get-Content at 06:06:28 UTC, after blind commit 0848fc7 at 06:06:13 UTC. pack.json, pack.md, verification.json, drafts, followup, adjudication and review notes were not intentionally opened. Whole-index privacy scans mechanically read them only after the blind commit.
independence.mechanical_reads: git fetch and worktree checkout transferred/materialized objects before drafting. pnpm check:privacy first attempted after blind commit at approximately 06:06 UTC; sandbox pnpm registration failed before scanning. The successful outside-sandbox run began around 06:07 UTC and mechanically read all 2,312 indexed files using git show, including held files, without displaying their text. Its pnpm dependency setup also read manifests/lockfile and created ignored node_modules. No held text was intentionally inspected until the comparison file read after the blind commit. Editorial tests also imported historical review/data fixtures after Part A was committed; sandbox run began at approximately 06:15 UTC and the outside-sandbox retry followed at approximately 06:16 UTC.
independence.timing: Prior report read occurred after worktree creation and before first source retrieval at 06:00:54 UTC on 2026-11-05. All sources inspected before Part A was written.
independence.privacy_scan_timing: Whole-index baseline scan ran approximately 06:07–06:12 UTC, passed for 2,312 files before the blind-answer push. Final privacy validation uses a separate temporary index containing only the two final reports, so it does not rescan unrelated held files or modify the real index.

method: Direct HTTP, sequential; at least eight seconds between requests to each host. Initial sandbox Node fetch and curl failed DNS for the two live PDF hosts; successful curl requests ran outside the sandbox. Temporary response bodies and PDF renders remain untracked. Visual inspection of PDF pages; HTML text decoded without executing scripts. Displayed Metaculus values only. Signed query strings are excluded. One pacing deviation: the first Kurzweil April replay used curl -L and automatically followed its redirect to August without an enforced eight-second inter-hop pause. Subsequent replay requests disabled automatic redirects; separate requests were paced at least eight seconds apart. The redirect is disclosed and its August body is not described as an April capture.
